en: Sura 76: Al-Insan
ja: 第76章 人間章

p.src: 76:1  Was there not a period of time when man was not a thing [even] mentioned[1]?

en: Was there not a period of time when man was not a thing [even] mentioned[1]?
ja: 人間には（そこに魂を吹き込まれる以前）、言及すべき何ものでもなかった長い一時期が、確かに訪れたではないか？[1]
u.src: 76:1  Was there not a period of time when man was not a thing [even] mentioned[1]?

en: [1] Before coming into being.
ja: [1]　人は以前、根源的物質や液体といった、人間としての特性がない、取るに足らない存在だった（アル＝バイダーウィー５：４2５参照）。

p.src: 76:2  Indeed, We created man from a drop of mixed fluids[2], in order to test him. So We gave him hearing and sight.

en: Indeed, We created man from a drop of mixed fluids[2], in order to test him. So We gave him hearing and sight.
ja: 本当にわれら*は人間を、（男女の精液が）混じり合った、一滴の精液から創造した。われら*は彼を（その後、宗教的な義務によって）試練にかけるのだ[1]。われら*は彼を聞き、見る者とした。
u.src: 76:2  Indeed, We created man from a drop of mixed fluids[2], in order to test him. So We gave him hearing and sight.

en: [2] A combination of male and female gametes (sperm and egg) which form the zygote after fertilization in the womb.
ja: [1]　蜘蛛章2、および王権章2「試練」の訳注も参照。

p.src: 76:3  Indeed, We showed him the way, whether he is grateful or ungrateful.

en: Indeed, We showed him the way, whether he is grateful or ungrateful.
ja: 本当にわれら*は彼を、道[1]へと導いた。感謝する者か、あるいは大層な恩知らずか（となるべく）。
u.src: 76:3  Indeed, We showed him the way, whether he is grateful or ungrateful.

ja: [1]　正しい導きと迷い、善と悪という「道」（ムヤッサル５７８頁参照）。

p.src: 76:4  We have surely prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a Blazing Fire.

en: We have surely prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a Blazing Fire.
ja: 本当にわれら*は不信仰者*たちに、鎖と枷と（地獄の）烈火を用意した。
u.src: 76:4  We have surely prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a Blazing Fire.

p.src: 76:5  Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] flavored with camphor[3],

en: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] flavored with camphor[3],
ja: 実に（アッラー*への義務を果たす）善行者たちは（復活の日*）、その混ぜ物が樟脳である（酒の）盃から飲む。[1]
u.src: 76:5  Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] flavored with camphor[3],

en: [3] "Kāfoor": a sweet-scent spring in Paradise.
ja: [1]　天国の民の飲み物については、アーヤ*1７－1８、21、サード章５1、整列者章４５ー４７、詳細にされた章３1、ムハンマド*章1５、出来事章1７－1９、消息章３４、量を減らす者たち章2５－2８も参照。

p.src: 76:6  a spring from which Allah’s slaves will drink, which will flow as they wish.

en: a spring from which Allah’s slaves will drink, which will flow as they wish.
ja: つまり、アッラー*の僕たちが（思うがまま）容易に噴き出させつつ飲む、泉である。
u.src: 76:6  a spring from which Allah’s slaves will drink, which will flow as they wish.

p.src: 76:7  They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil will spread far and wide,

en: They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil will spread far and wide,
ja: 彼ら（善行者たち）は（現世で）誓約を全うし、（アッラー*がご慈悲をおかけになった者を除く全ての者に）その悪が拡散する（復活の）日を怖れ、
u.src: 76:7  They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil will spread far and wide,

p.src: 76:8  and they give food, despite their love for it[4], to the needy, the orphans, and the captives,

en: and they give food, despite their love for it[4], to the needy, the orphans, and the captives,
ja: 自らの（それに対する）愛着にも関わらず、貧弱*、孤児、捕虜に食べ物を食べさせるのだから。
u.src: 76:8  and they give food, despite their love for it[4], to the needy, the orphans, and the captives,

en: [4] Or "out of love for Him (Allah)".

p.src: 76:9  [saying to themselves] “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we seek from you neither reward nor gratitude.

en: [saying to themselves] “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we seek from you neither reward nor gratitude.
ja: （彼らは心中で、こう言うのだ。）「私たちがあなた方に食べさせるのは、アッラー*の御顔ゆえに外ならない。私たちはあなた方から、見返りも感謝もいらない。
u.src: 76:9  [saying to themselves] “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we seek from you neither reward nor gratitude.

p.src: 76:10  We fear from our Lord a grim and distressful Day.”

en: We fear from our Lord a grim and distressful Day.”
ja: 本当に私たちは、眉をしかめる凄まじい日の、我らが主*を怖れているのだから」。
u.src: 76:10  We fear from our Lord a grim and distressful Day.”

p.src: 76:11  So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day, and will grant them radiance and delight,

en: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day, and will grant them radiance and delight,
ja: それでアッラー*は、その日の悪から彼らをお守りになり、彼らに（顔の）輝きと（心の）喜びをお授けになった。
u.src: 76:11  So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day, and will grant them radiance and delight,

p.src: 76:12  and will reward them for their perseverance with Paradise and garments of silk.

en: and will reward them for their perseverance with Paradise and garments of silk.
ja: そして彼らが（現世で）忍耐*したことゆえに、彼らを楽園と絹（の衣服[1]）でお報いになった。
u.src: 76:12  and will reward them for their perseverance with Paradise and garments of silk.

ja: [1]　天国の民の衣服については、アーヤ*21、洞窟章３1、巡礼*章2３、創成者*章３３、煙霧章５1ー５３も参照。

p.src: 76:13  They will recline therein on adorned couches; neither feeling scorching heat[5] nor freezing cold.

en: They will recline therein on adorned couches; neither feeling scorching heat[5] nor freezing cold.
ja: 彼らはそこで、寝台に寄りかかっている。彼らはそこで、太陽（の灼熱）も酷寒も見出すことがない。
u.src: 76:13  They will recline therein on adorned couches; neither feeling scorching heat[5] nor freezing cold.

en: [5] i.e., the sun.

p.src: 76:14  with shady branches spread above them, and clusters of fruit will be made within their reach.

en: with shady branches spread above them, and clusters of fruit will be made within their reach.
ja: また、彼らの上には（、楽園の木々の）その陰が間近に（覆いかぶさって）あり、その果実の房は（手近に）低く垂れ下げられている。
u.src: 76:14  with shady branches spread above them, and clusters of fruit will be made within their reach.

p.src: 76:15  They will be served frequently with silver vessels and crystal cups,

en: They will be served frequently with silver vessels and crystal cups,
ja: また彼らには、銀の食器と硝子の杯と共に（奉仕する少年たちが）回らせられる。
u.src: 76:15  They will be served frequently with silver vessels and crystal cups,

p.src: 76:16  crystalline goblets of silver, filled precisely as desired.

en: crystalline goblets of silver, filled precisely as desired.
ja: 彼らがちょうどいい分量に合わせた、銀製の硝子[1]（の杯と共に）。
u.src: 76:16  crystalline goblets of silver, filled precisely as desired.

ja: [1]　つまり、その杯は銀製にも関わらず、がらすの透明さを備えている（アル＝クルトゥビー1９：1４０参照）。

p.src: 76:17  They will be given a glass [of wine] flavored with ginger

en: They will be given a glass [of wine] flavored with ginger
ja: また彼らはそこで、その混ぜ物が生姜である（酒の）盃を飲まされる。
u.src: 76:17  They will be given a glass [of wine] flavored with ginger

p.src: 76:18  from a spring therein called Salsabīl.

en: from a spring therein called Salsabīl.
ja: つまりサルサビール[1]と呼ばれる、そこ（楽園）にある泉の（生姜[2]である）。
u.src: 76:18  from a spring therein called Salsabīl.

ja: [1]　「サルサビール」とは、「サラサ（滑らかである）」という語から派生していると言われるように、飲む者の喉にも、その流れる状態も滑らかであり、天国の民はそれをどこにでも好きなように操（あやつ）ることが出来る（アッ＝タバリー1０：８３７６参照）。 [2]　つまり、その泉につけられた生姜である。あるいは生姜から抽出（ちゅうしゅつ）された液体が、泉のように豊富である（イブン・アーシュール2９：３９５参照）。また、天国の民の飲み物については、アーヤ*５、21、サード章５1、整列者章４５－４７、詳細にされた章３1、ムハンマド*章1５、出来事章1７－1９、消息章３４、量を減らす者たち章2５－2８も参照。

p.src: 76:19  They will be served by eternal young boys; if you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.

en: They will be served by eternal young boys; if you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.
ja: また、永遠の少年たちが、彼らの周りを（奉仕のために）回って歩く。もしあなたが彼らを見れば、彼らを散りばめられた真珠かと思ったであろう。
u.src: 76:19  They will be served by eternal young boys; if you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.

p.src: 76:20  If you were to look around, you would see bliss and a vast dominion.

en: If you were to look around, you would see bliss and a vast dominion.
ja: そして、あなたがそこで（天国のいかなる場所でも）見れば、安楽と、大いなる王国を目にしたことであろう。
u.src: 76:20  If you were to look around, you would see bliss and a vast dominion.

p.src: 76:21  They will be dressed in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

en: They will be dressed in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.
ja: 彼らの上には、緑色の精巧な絹地と重厚な絹地の衣服。そして銀製の腕輪で飾り立てられ[1]、彼らの主*は彼らに清い水を飲ませて下さる。
u.src: 76:21  They will be dressed in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

ja: [1]　天国の民の衣服については、アーヤ*21、洞窟章３1、巡礼*章2３、創成者*章３３、煙霧章５1ー５３も参照。

p.src: 76:22  [And they will be told,] “Indeed, this is your reward, and your efforts have been appreciated.”

en: [And they will be told,] “Indeed, this is your reward, and your efforts have been appreciated.”
ja: （彼らには、こう言われる。）「本当にこれはもとより、あなた方への（正しい行い*の）報いである。そして、あなた方の（現世での）努力は、（アッラー*の御許で）労われる[1]ことになっていたのだ」。
u.src: 76:22  [And they will be told,] “Indeed, this is your reward, and your efforts have been appreciated.”

ja: [1]　頻出名・用語解説の「よく労（ねぎら）われる*お方」の項も参照。

p.src: 76:23  Indeed, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you in stages.

en: Indeed, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you in stages.
ja: （使徒*よ、）本当にわれら*はあなたに、クルアーン*を徐々に下した[1]。
u.src: 76:23  Indeed, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you in stages.

ja: [1]　「徐々に下した」に関しては、夜の旅章1０６、識別章３2とそれらの訳注も参照。

p.src: 76:24  So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not obey any sinner or disbeliever from among them.

en: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not obey any sinner or disbeliever from among them.
ja: ならば、あなたの主*のお決めになったことゆえに忍耐*し、彼ら（シルク*の徒）の内の罪に溺れた者にも、不信仰この上ない者にも、従うのではない。
u.src: 76:24  So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not obey any sinner or disbeliever from among them.

p.src: 76:25  And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening[6],

en: And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening[6],
ja: また、あなたの主*を朝に夕に念じ、
u.src: 76:25  And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening[6],

en: [6] This and the next verse refer to the five daily prayers: here it refers to the dawn prayer, then the noon and afternoon prayers.

p.src: 76:26  and prostrate to Him at night, and glorify Him at length by night[7].

en: and prostrate to Him at night, and glorify Him at length by night[7].
ja: 夜の一部にはかれにサジダ*し、かれを夜長く称える*[1]のだ。
u.src: 76:26  and prostrate to Him at night, and glorify Him at length by night[7].

en: [7] It refers to the sunset and night prayers.
ja: [1]　これはタハッジュド（夜の旅章７９の訳注を参照）のことを指す、とされる（ムヤッサル５８０頁参照）。

p.src: 76:27  Indeed, these [pagans] love this fleeting life and pay no heed to a heavy Day ahead of them.

en: Indeed, these [pagans] love this fleeting life and pay no heed to a heavy Day ahead of them.
ja: 本当にこれらの者たち（シルク*の徒）は、手っ取り早いもの[1]を愛し、自分たちの背後に（復活の日*という）重大な日（のための行い）を、放ったらかしにしている[2]。
u.src: 76:27  Indeed, these [pagans] love this fleeting life and pay no heed to a heavy Day ahead of them.

ja: [1]　「手っ取り早いもの」については、復活章2０－21とその訳注も参照。 [2]　「自分たちの前方にある復活の日*への信仰を、放ったらかしにしている」という解釈もある（アル＝クルトゥビー1９：1５1参照）。

p.src: 76:28  It is We Who created them and strengthened their build. If We will, We can replace them with others like them.

en: It is We Who created them and strengthened their build. If We will, We can replace them with others like them.
ja: われら*が彼らを創り、その繋ぎ目を堅固にしたのだ[1]。そして、もしわれら*が望んだなら（彼らを）、彼らと似た者たち（だが、われら*に従順な者たち）とすっかり取り替えてしまったであろう。[2]
u.src: 76:28  It is We Who created them and strengthened their build. If We will, We can replace them with others like them.

ja: [1]　骨や神経や血管で、身体の各部をしっかりと繋ぎ止めたということ（イブン・アーシュール2９：４０９参照）。 [2]　彼らの姿形を、醜いものに変えてしまっただろう、という解釈もある（アル＝クルトゥビー1９：1５2参照）。

p.src: 76:29  Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who wills may take a way to his Lord.

en: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who wills may take a way to his Lord.
ja: 本当にこれ（このスーラ*）は、教訓。そして、誰でも（それによる教訓を）望む者には、（信仰心と敬虔*さによって）自らの主*（のご満悦）へと道を取らせよ。
u.src: 76:29  Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who wills may take a way to his Lord.

p.src: 76:30  But you cannot will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

en: But you cannot will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
ja: そしてあなた方は、アッラー*がお望みにならない限り、（いかなることも）望むことがない[1]。本当にアッラー*は、もとより全知者、英知あふれる*お方であられるのだから。
u.src: 76:30  But you cannot will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

ja: [1]　包る者章５６の、同様の件（くだり）の訳注も参照。

p.src: 76:31  He admits whom He wills into His mercy, but for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.

en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy, but for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.
ja: かれは、かれがお望みになる（信仰）者を、そのご慈悲の中にお入れになる。そして不正*者たち、彼らには痛ましい懲罰を用意されたのだ。
u.src: 76:31  He admits whom He wills into His mercy, but for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.
